posts.caption:
GTA VI's soundtrack just got 23 songs bigger 🎮

Rockstar dropped the deluxe edition of GTA VI: The Album on Monday. The rappers who play characters in the story are on it too: Krissy Celess and Hood Brat as Real Dimez, Denzel Curry as DWNPLY, and Kodak Black as himself.

Who's your favorite character in the game so far?

Riffex is for fans who find artists early. Join the waitlist at riffex.app.

#gtavi #gta6 #denzelcurry #kodakblack #newmusic
